events.title: Demo Update v0.9.9 – Fire- and Water-Armored Gorotsuki, and Rushes You Can Steal
events.summary: Elemental-armored Gorotsuki Gorotsuki wearing fire armor or water armor now appear on Floor 1 (the room changes every run) Armor breaks in one hit from its weakness: water douses fire, fire is fanned by wind, wind scatters water. Any other element breaks it in two hits While armored, sword hits won't make them flinch. Once the armor breaks, they stagger for a while Water armor is a clear, flowing film of water; fire armor has flames crawling over the shell More rushes to steal Flame Rush: charge

events.title: Next Fest: DIMAZE Demo Gameplay Live
events.summary: During Steam Next Fest (Oct 20–27), we are streaming DIMAZE demo gameplay right here on the store page. While enemies are casting fireballs, lasers and ice spears, swallow the whole spell circle with your Drain Hole, store the mana, and fire it back. The free demo takes about 15 minutes. MAJAK, the tower warden, waits on floor 3. If it looks fun, please add DIMAZE to your wishlist!

events.title: Demo Update v0.9.8 – A Living Vortex and a Wind-Clad Rush
events.summary: Thank you for playing the DIMAZE demo. We've updated the demo for the start of Steam Next Fest. A shorter demo The demo now runs Floor 1 → Floor 2 → Floor 3, where the boss (Majak) appears. You can reach the boss in a short session The Floor 2 key sits on an altar — take it and enemies swarm in Pots now drop 10x more gold The Drain Hole is alive The vortex now writhes with your arm. events.title: Demo Update v0.9.7 – Mana, a New Opening, and Floors With Character
events.summary: Thank you for playing the DIMAZE demo! Ahead of Steam Next Fest, which starts on October 20, the demo has received a major update. Mana Stolen spells no longer use charges. They now cost Mana, shown on the ring around your Drain Hole button. Drain a magic circle while an enemy is casting to learn that skill. Skills you learn stay with you even after you fall. events.title: Demo Update v0.9.6 – Elemental Ores, the Katana, Objectives, New Scrolls
events.summary: Thank you for playing the DIMAZE demo. DIMAZE is taking part in Steam Next Fest, starting October 20. Ahead of the festival, the demo has received a major update. Elemental ores Four kinds of elemental ore now grow along the dungeon walls: Thunder, Flame, Venom and Frost Strike them with a sword to break them. Bare fists work too, but staves and fireballs bounce off Elemental imbuing Breaking an ore imbues you with its element for a while, and your basic attacks with a compatible weapon carry it

events.title: Demo Update v0.9.5 – New Enemy Banja, Flow, and a Dungeon That Branches
events.summary: Thank you for playing the DIMAZE demo. Alongside a new enemy, Banja, this update focuses on two things: how it feels while you're swinging, and how it feels while you're lost. New enemy: Banja A new enemy, Banja, has appeared. It parries your magic and sends it right back, so time your spells carefully Defeating it drops Banja's Crystal Face, which now comes in rarities from Common to Legendary.
